correctness.rationale: A rank-one sp(V) operator X_u=u⊗ω(u,.) has X_u²=0 and commutator zero with X_v exactly when ω(u,v)=0. Coordinatewise ± quotient of the isotropic vector nullcone describes the reduced variety in char≠2. Fiber dimension over isotropic s-planes yields irreducible global dimension; linearize nonzero vector coordinates and zero quadratic Veronese cones to obtain dim T=r(2n−s)+s(s+1)/2+(r−t)binom(2n−s,2). Comparing with global dimension gives precisely the stated smoothness trichotomy including zero-coordinate singularities for n>=2. A finite-field count uses symplectic isotropic Grassmann numbers times the number of spanning ordered images, ∏(q^r−q^j). Independently enumerated n=1 over q=3,5 and checked small symbolic tangent dimension inequalities; finite tests are not general proofs.
